title: AlphaSense Introduces SuperAnalyst, an Always-On Agent That Can Source and Conduct Expert Calls
summary: AlphaSense announced SuperAnalyst, an always-on AI agent that runs multi-step financial and strategic workflows across the AlphaSense platform. Capabilities described in the release include monitoring filings, earnings, expert transcripts, and research around the clock; autonomously identifying experts and conducting expert calls; retaining project history across sessions; and producing Excel models, Word memos, PowerPoint decks, and source-linked reports. At launch it was available to select enterprise customers through an early access program, with availability expanding progressively.
whyItMatters: SuperAnalyst folds expert identification and interviewing into an autonomous agent workflow, positioning primary research as one step an AI system can initiate rather than a separately procured service.
